{{Quote|Sergeant 7719, while we cannot officially commend you, we see no reason to punish you, either. You're to be redeployed to another world and rotated into a new unit.|A [[Republic officer/Legends|Republic officer]], to Banks|<ref name="TEW" />}}
A '''snowy planet''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
{{Quote|What's the hold-up, 7719&mdash;you have somewhere better to be?''"<br />"''There's no such place, General Swan.|[[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan]] and Banks|<ref name="TEW" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this [[Water/Legends|snowy]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] housed a [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan]] was in charge of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] stationed there. [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Banks (clone)|Banks]] was sent to this world following his previous [[Mission to Oznek|mission]] on the planet [[Oznek]].<ref name="TEW" />
